column5: Map Entra ID groups to Workbench roles
column6: As a security administrator, I want each Entra ID group mapped to one Workbench role in each environment as a data row, so that a person gets their roles from the group the bank IAM grants, with no code change.
column11: Rules and parameters R; Rules and parameters C

column5: Permission matrix as a versioned load
column6: As an application owner, I want the permission matrix of roles against the 14 capability areas loaded as a versioned file, so that a permission changes without a code release and every change has an approver.
column11: Rules and parameters A; Reference data C

column6: As an application owner, I want each role given a scope of own cases, team, region or all as data, so that a person sees only the cases their role allows.
column11: Platform administration R

column6: As a Compliance and PDPA officer, I want a masking profile per role and per personal field held as data, naming the view column the masked value comes from, so that personal data is shown only to the roles allowed to see it and the clear identity number never leaves ACE.

column11: Reference data C; Reference data A

column5: Separation of duty check at sign-in
column6: As a security administrator, I want a session refused when a person's groups hold a conflicting role pair, so that no one holds two roles the separation of duty table forbids.
column11: Rules and parameters C; Rules and parameters A

column6: As a platform administrator, I want emergency access beyond my role, tied to an open incident, ending on its own, so that an incident can be fixed without a permanent grant.
column11: Platform administration R

column6: As an internal auditor, I want the access log searched by person, date, event and capability area, with export, so that I can show who accessed what without asking IT.
column11: Platform administration R; Rules and parameters R

column6: As a role owner, I want a list of every holder of my roles each review cycle, to confirm or remove, so that access is recertified on schedule.

column5: Load a list of values version
column6: As a reference data administrator, I want a list of values loaded as a new version with a valid from date, so that a code list changes without a code release.
column11: Rules and parameters R; Rules and parameters A

column6: As a list owner, I want to approve or reject a loaded version before it takes effect, so that no reference data changes without its owner.

column6: As a center of excellence analyst, I want a route set loaded as a new rule version where each row names its test case, so that rules change as data and every row is tested.
column11: Rules and parameters A; Rules and parameters R

column6: As a risk and model risk officer, I want to approve a rule version that has passed its tests, with its valid from date, so that only tested and approved rules decide cases.
column11: Rules and parameters A; Rules and parameters R

column5: Roll back a rule or reference version
column6: As a reference data administrator, I want the previous version restored through the same load, so that a bad change is undone in minutes.

column6: As a reference data administrator, I want queues with their team, role, assignment method, caseload cap and overflow queue loaded as data, so that allocation follows the team set-up without a code change.

column6: As a reference data administrator, I want the time allowed in each case state, its warning and its escalation point loaded as data, so that clocks and escalations follow the agreed service levels.

column5: Load the delegation of authority table
column6: As a reference data administrator, I want approval levels, limits, holders and substitutes loaded as data with effective dates, so that approvals route by the regulation without a code change.

column6: As a legal counsel, I want templates by type, product and language approved by Legal before use, and withdrawn when they change, so that every notice uses wording Legal has approved.

column6: As a platform administrator, I want every Workbench job and outbound action with its status, business date, duration and checks, and the last complete ACE business date per source beside it, so that a failed job is found and rerun the same morning and a late ACE batch is not mistaken for a failed job.
